info.title: Faraz Engineering Portfolio API
info.description:
API documentation for the **Faraz Engineering Portfolio** application.

**Authentication:** Most endpoints require the `api_key` header. If using Swagger UI, click the **Authorize** button at the top of the page and enter your API key before trying any endpoint.

get.description: Retrieve a list of Recommendation records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Field name to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending order, e.g. -created_date

delete.description: **Warning:** Passing an empty `{}` query will delete ALL records in this entity.

schema.description: Query filter to match records to delete

put.description: Each item must include an 'id' field along with the fields to update.

patch.summary: Update many Recommendation records by query
patch.description: Update multiple records matching a query filter. Supports MongoDB update operators ($set, $inc, $push, $pull).

get.summary: Get a Recommendation record by ID

delete.description: Soft-deletes the record. Use the restore endpoint to undo.

ApiKeyAuth.name: api_key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your API key. Obtain it from your user profile or via `User.me()` in the app SDK.

name.description: Name of the person writing the recommendation

status.description: Review state — only approved recommendations are published

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the record

Recommendation.description: Endorsements submitted by engineers, consultants, contractors and clients. Published only after review.

path.description: Dot path into the content object, e.g. hero.lead or projects.items.0.title

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the record

TextOverride.description: Section-by-section text overrides for the portfolio, keyed by content path and language. Empty means the built-in default is used.

source_url.description: The English PDF this version was written from

source_title.description: File name of the English PDF

content.description: JSON: name, title, contact and sections of the Arabic CV

translated_at.description: When the Arabic version was generated

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the record

CvVersion.description: The Arabic version of the CV, written automatically from the English PDF uploaded in the dashboard and used for the Arabic download.

kind.description: What this file is used for

slug.description: Project slug this file belongs to (project covers and videos)

url.description: Public file URL or external video link

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the record

MediaItem.description: The intro video, CV file, drawing sheet section cover, project cover photos, project videos and project drawing files shown on the portfolio, managed from the dashboard.

slug.description: URL id of the project page, e.g. padel-lighting

title_ar.description: Project name in Arabic (English is used when empty)

summary_en.description: One or two lines describing the work, in English

summary_ar.description: Summary in Arabic (English is used when empty)

tags.description: Comma separated tags, e.g. Power, Lighting, ELV

office.description: Mode of work, e.g. Design office or Site team

standards.description: Comma separated standards, e.g. SBC, IEC

scope_en.description: Scope delivered in English, one item per line

scope_ar.description: Scope delivered in Arabic, one item per line (English is used when empty)

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the record

Project.description: Portfolio projects added from the dashboard. They appear after the built-in projects on the site, with their own page, cover and video.

full_name.description: The full name of the user

role.description: The role of the user in the app

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the record
